instruction.text: Complete the sentence by writing the correct spelling of the word in the gap.

atoms.b: The pyramids are still in ((existence)) today.
atoms.finishSound: The pyramids are still in existence today.

atoms.b: She gave her ((neighbour)) a spare key.
atoms.finishSound: She gave her neighbour a spare key.

atoms.b: I like all kinds of chocolate without ((prejudice)).
atoms.finishSound: I like all kinds of chocolate without prejudice.

atoms.b: Politicians must ((recognise)) the need for a new law.
atoms.finishSound: Politicians must recognise the need for a new law.

atoms.b: People used to make a ((sacrifice)) to appease the gods.
atoms.finishSound: People used to make a sacrifice to appease the gods.

atoms.b: My ((secretary)) will arrange a meeting over the phone.
atoms.finishSound: My secretary will arrange a meeting over the phone.

atoms.b: I became ((conscious)) of someone watching me.
atoms.finishSound: I became conscious of someone watching me.
